full_judgment:
Nazmun Ara Sultana, J. This Civil Petition for Leave to Appeal, at the instance of the pre-emptee-opposite party, is directed against the judgment and order dated 17.05.2009 passed by the High Court Division in Civil Revision No. 3998 of 2001 discharging the rule. The necessary facts for disposal of this Civil Petition for Leave to Appeal in short, are that the opposite party No. 1, as pre-emptor, instituted Miscellaneous Case No. 12 of 1997 in the Court of the Assistant Judge, Rajarhat, Kurigram under section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act stating that he was a co-sharer of the case holding while the pre-emptee-opposite party No. 1 was a stranger to that. That the vendor-opposite party No. 2 sold the case land to the pre-emptee-opposite party No. 1 by the kabala dated 26.09.1996 beyond the knowledge of the pre-emptor-petitioner. The pre-emptor came to know about the said deed on 06.03.1997 and thereafter he instituted the case for pre-emption after depositing the requisite amount. 

 2. The pre-emptee-opposite party No. 1 contested that case by filing written statement. His case was that the case of pre-emption was barred by limitation and also barred by principle of waiver, estoppel and acquiescence. That the pre-emptee-opposite party purchased the case land within the full knowledge of the pre-emptor-petitioner-who also negotiated the same and after purchase the pre-emptee-opposite party spent tk. 4,000/- for development of the case land.
